people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
translations.bsb: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
translations.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do ➔ these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
translations.asv: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth. Men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.
